blocks.text: Association do classes ke beech relationship (rishta) hai. Is ki do types hain:

items: Aggregation: ek class (maslan Library) doosri class (maslan Book) ko rakhti hai magar us ki owner (maalik) nahi. Kitabein library ke baghair bhi alag se reh sakti hain.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"class Book :" aur "self.title = title": Book class har kitab ka title rakhti hai.
"class Library :" aur "self.books = [ ]": Library bante waqt kitabon ki khaali list banti hai.
"def add_book(self, book):": bahar bane hue Book object ko list mein jorta hai (append).
"print("Book ", book.title, "added to the library.")": kitab jurne ka message; "Book " ke andar bhi space hai, is liye output mein "Book" ke baad do spaces aate hain.
Yeh aggregation hai: Book objects Library se alag bante hain aur Library ke baghair bhi reh sakte hain.
Yahan sirf classes define hui hain; koi object nahi bana aur add_book bulaya nahi gaya, is liye chalane par kuch print nahi hota. Agla "Khud chala kar dekhein" program inhein istemal karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke code mein yeh ghaltiyan hain: self, books = [ ] (comma) ki jagah self.books = [ ] (dot) hona chahiye, warna ValueError aata hai; def add_book Library class ke andar indented hona chahiye aur us ki dono lines us ke neeche (print line zyada aage khiski hui hai); aur "added to the library.” tirchhi quote par khatam hai, is liye string band nahi hoti. Theek code oopar hai.
Yeh aggregation ki misaal hai: Book objects alag bante hain aur phir Library mein jorte hain. titles ki list mein kitabon ke naam badal kar ya barha kar Run karein.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"titles = ["Python Basics", "Computer Science XI"]": kitabon ke naamon ki list.
"class Book:" aur "class Library:": Book title rakhti hai; Library ke paas books ki list aur add_book method hai jo kitab jor kar message print karta hai.
"library = Library()": ek library object banta hai jis ki list khaali hai.
"for title in titles:": har naam par loop ek baar chalta hai.
"library.add_book(Book(title))": pehle us naam se Book object banta hai, phir library mein jurta hai; har dafa message print hota hai.
"print("Library mein kul books:", len(library.books))": list mein kitabein ginta hai.
Output: "Book Python Basics added to the library.", "Book Computer Science XI added to the library." aur "Library mein kul books: 2".
Khud try karein: titles mein "Physics XI" bhi jor kar Run karein: teesri "added" line aayegi aur "Library mein kul books: 3".
Composition: ek class (maslan House) doosri class (maslan Room) ko rakhti bhi hai aur us ki maalik bhi hai. Rooms (kamre) ghar ke baghair nahi reh sakte.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"class Room:" aur "self.name = name": Room class kamre ka naam rakhti hai.
"class House :" aur "def __init__(self) :": House ka constructor.
"self.rooms = [Room("Living Room"), Room( " Bedroom")]": House khud apne andar do Room objects banata hai. Yahi composition hai: ghar kamron ka maalik hai, kamre ghar ke saath bante hain aur ghar ke baghair nahi rehte. (Kitab ke " Bedroom" mein shuru mein ek space hai; output par is ka asar nahi.)
"print ("House with rooms created")": ghar banne ka message.
"house = House()": House object banta hai, is liye constructor chalta hai; aakhir wala "# prints: ..." comment hai.
Output: House with rooms created
Khud try karein: aakhir mein print(house.rooms[0].name) jor kar Run karein: "Living Room" bhi aayega.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab self.name = name ko margin par chhapti hai; yeh __init__ ke andar indented honi chahiye (IndentationError). House ke andar print mein tirchhe quotes (“ ”) hain jo Python nahi maanti; seedhe quotes lagayein. Aakhri line print("House with rooms created.") class ke bahar ek faltu copy hai. Ghar house = House() se banta hai, aur yeh "House with rooms created" print karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Student aur school aggregation hai ya composition?
blocks.explanation: Aggregation: school mein students hain, magar student school ke baghair bhi apni jagah maujood rehta hai.

items: Composition: rakhti bhi aur maalik bhi (House-Room).
